Kristian went on a driving holiday.
First he drove to a friend's in Kragerø.
sentences.Kragerø er en koselig, liten by ved kyst: Kragerø is a cosy little town on the coast.
sentences.Men været var elendig, og de satt inne o: But the weather was terrible, and they sat indoors playing cards every day.
sentences.Etter to uker dro de på bluesfestival på: After two weeks they went to a blues festival in Notodden.
They had a great time there.
sentences.De hørte på musikk fra morgen til kveld,: They listened to music from morning till night, drank beer and talked to other blues fans.
sentences.Det var mye folk overalt, i gatene og på: There were lots of people everywhere, in the streets and in the clubs, and it wasn't easy to find a place to stay the night.
sentences.Heldigvis fikk de plass på en campingpla: Luckily they got a spot at a campsite nearby.
